result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact, but a loading spinner sits on top of an already-complete popular restaurant card, which looks like a stuck or misplaced loading state.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card even though the restaurant image, name, rating, delivery time, and category are already fully visible. This looks like a stuck or incorrectly placed loading indicator.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the card content has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder instead of overlaying a spinner on finished content.
